exploration.title: Ten-Minute Certainty
openQuestions: Is full canonical citation corpus replay required on every PR (R1), or is smoke-on-PR plus merge-group or nightly replay enough (Q13)? This decides whether Heavy / Test Integration can drop to a few minutes per PR.
Should Heavy / Coverage Regression become a required context, paired with a cheap touched-package ratchet before publish, or should Yeet stop gating mergeable on a non-required context?
Does this packet supersede the ci-lane-economics 20-minute p95 charter, and who owns the ProofLedger C4.2 enforcement flip while time-to-certainty is paused?
May phase 2 move a class of assurance from every PR to a periodic gate (a trust-cadence change), or must every current obligation stay on every selected PR?
What representative workstation fan-out (simultaneous agents, workload mix, protected non-agent reserve) is the acceptance condition for scheduler changes?
Does the 2026-11-08 pause on the R2 cache operational and qualification work bind this packet's implementation phase?
Money levers (standing heavy-pool cap, EC2 for short lanes, the org concurrent-job limit) stay out of scope unless the operator opens them; confirm.
